create_photo_system: create a photometric optimization system by calling create_photo_system with poses, depth, affine params, and graph config to build H and g matrices
get_pose_pairs: get matching pose pair indices between two pose sets using nearest, radius, or nearest_and_radius mode via get_pose_pairs
linearize_transformation: linearize the relative transformation between two camera poses and 3D points using linearize_transformation to get Jacobians
batch_photometric_constraints: batch photometric error constraints across pose pairs by calling batch_photometric_constraints to accumulate Hessian and gradient blocks
robustify_photo_system_inplace: robustify photometric residuals in-place using Huber weighting via robustify_photo_system_inplace with a given noise sigma
